editorial.name: Cofounder
editorial.descriptionZh: Cofounder 自称 agent 编排平台，按部门（Strategy、Finance、Marketing、Design、Sales、Operations 等）把活派给 agent，你在危险动作上做审批。首屏是一幅像素画：草地上的笔记本电脑、一本摊开的笔记本和一只瓢虫。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看 AI agent 产品怎么用像素插画讲叙事
editorial.noteZh: 首屏背景是一整张 pixel art：远景是城市天际线，近处草坡上摆着一台打开的笔电与一本摊开的本子，右下角一只红色瓢虫，画面上漂着两块深色浮标——Task Completed Marketing Campaign 与 Task Completed New webpage。左边主标 Cofounder lets you run an entire company with AI，副标写 Start with an AI roadmap, then hand off engineering, sales, marketing, design, finance, and ops to agents.，按钮是 Run a company 与 Check out the launch。正文 Agentic departments 一段说它 designed like a real company, with departments, managers, and shared context，并给出 Human in the loop（危险动作要审批）与 Fully extensible（可接 MCP、custom APIs、custom skills）两条；1.0 LAUNCH 一节列了 1.1 Business positioning、1.2 Brand identity、1.3 Marketing website、1.4 Launch content 四步，任务板上还有 Incorporate LLC 这种标着 Agent requires approval 的条目。正文写 over 10,650 companies are running on Cofounder。

reasons.statement: 页面讲的全是 Cofounder 自家的 agent 编排平台——部门划分、审批机制与启动清单，因此归产品与公司官网；这条候选来自 saaslandingpage.com 的落地页灵感目录。
